$comment: Same third-pass fix as Route 2. A player raising a team arrives here at THIRTEEN, not the seventeen a solo lead reaches, and -- this is the part two earlier passes never measured -- their starter has NOT EVOLVED YET, because all three starters evolve at 16. The whole middle of the game was being fought with a first-stage kin against a band built for a second-stage one, which read 70/50/85 percent on an average roll. Every slot is now 10-12, one to three levels under the arriving player. The experience that capping a band would ordinarily cost is bought back by pinning the two heaviest payers LOW rather than high: Mossback (148 base experience, 412 points) and Emberbore (96) sit at 10-11 with their weight raised. That is the whole trick of this pass -- a fat kin at a low level is free experience, a fat kin at your level is a wall. Mean roll 12.8 -> 10.8, top 15 -> 12, experience per fight 114 -> 104.
